items.title: Derive and coordinate legal DONE-required timeout budgets
items.context: Create one shared sum(effective sequential command timeouts)+bounded grace budget. Use it for done_prepare's DONE-required phase and command-specific cli-engine default absolute maxima, while preserving per-command/phase/idle/max bounds and explicit phase/global/LATTICE_MAX_TIMEOUT_MS precedence. Report budget source and non-repeating timeout guidance.
items.userSees: done_prepare prints “DONE-required validation budget: <N>ms (derived|global_override|phase_override)” and direct/done_prepare commands are not killed by a shorter default CLI maximum.

happy.desc: Given ordered DONE-required commands with effective timeoutMs 290000 and 1200000, the shared budget calculator returns their sequential sum plus the documented bounded grace; done_prepare reports DONE-required validation budget: <N>ms (derived), and the default phase deadline and DONE-required CLI absolute max are each no shorter than that legal budget. WHY: proves outer defaults cannot deterministically preempt valid inner work.

Run the same policy through done_prepare and direct done_required_validate without timeout env overrides; both consume the same shared derived budget and complete with disposition=executed, result=pass, refusalReasons=[], timeoutLayer=null, while human output identifies the derived source. WHY: prevents handler and CLI budget drift.

edge.desc: Exercise one command, multiple sequential commands, explicit per-command timeouts, and commands using the default effective timeout; total uses each effective ordered timeout exactly once and adds bounded grace exactly once. WHY: covers sum-plus-grace arithmetic boundaries.

Set phase-specific, global phase, and LATTICE_MAX_TIMEOUT_MS overrides in combinations: phase-specific wins over global for the DONE-required phase, global wins over derived phase default when phase-specific is absent, and explicit max remains authoritative over derived max; selected source/value is reported. WHY: locks operator override precedence.

Supply timeout values whose sum is non-finite, non-positive, malformed, or beyond Node safe timer range; construction fails closed or applies the documented finite safe cap without overflow, wraparound, immediate accidental timeout, or an unbounded timer. WHY: protects timer-range boundaries.

Invoke unrelated ordinary CLI commands and both DONE-required entry paths; only done_required_validate and done_prepare validation receive the command-specific derived default max, unrelated commands retain the generic max, and positive LATTICE_MAX_TIMEOUT_MS overrides both. WHY: verifies command-specific CLI max derivation without globally weakening watchdog safety.

For done_prepare with validation enabled, compute its command-level default CLI max from the complete legal end-to-end closeout budget: the routine validate commands sequential budget plus every enabled closeout phase budget, including the derived DONE-required phase and any selected phase-specific or global phase overrides; the default max is not shorter than that total, while an explicit positive LATTICE_MAX_TIMEOUT_MS may intentionally terminate earlier and is attributed as max. WHY: prevents the top-level watchdog from preempting a legal multi-phase done_prepare run.

adversarial.desc: Race phase/max abort against final child completion at the deadline; exactly one terminal classification is emitted, result is pass or timed_out consistently, timeoutLayer names command|phase|max as applicable, and timers/listeners/processes are cleaned once. WHY: catches double settlement and deadline race leaks.

Force a derived phase timeout and inspect human plus JSON responses; disposition=executed, result=timed_out, refusalReasons and timeoutLayer identify the controlling layer/command, and the hint proposes inspection or a changed override/action rather than the identical deterministic rerun. WHY: ensures actionable non-looping failure UX.

verificationEvidence.note: Sequential 290000+1200000 timeout arithmetic is summed once plus bounded grace; effective runner timeout is capped legally.
Actual done_prepare and direct entry paths consume the shared budget and expose explicit structured reuse/execution terminals.
Table covers one/multiple/default/explicit effective timeouts, invalid values, bounded grace once, and real runner fallback.
Phase-specific, global phase, derived, and explicit CLI max precedence are asserted with selected values and timeout attribution.
Real runValidationCommand proves Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER is capped at MAX_NODE_TIMER_DELAY_MS and zero/negative/Infinity fall back without overflow.
Unrelated CLI generic max remains unchanged while DONE entry paths use derived budgets; explicit positive max remains authoritative.

Exact commandCliMaxBudget matrix asserts routine sequential budget plus each enabled phase exactly once: required/no-policy, validate true/false, six unique phase overrides and global override; omitting any of the five common closeout phases changes the expected total and fails.

Deterministic future/expired deadline seams plus abort-at-command-start event ordering prove one stable terminal, no late heartbeat, and no duplicate evidence; real CLI matrix covers command/idle/max.
Derived phase and parent idle/max timeout JSON assert executed/timed_out/refusalReasons/layer, nonzero status, and actionable non-looping guidance.

items.title: Reuse only structurally current DONE-required evidence
items.context: Add reuseFreshDoneRequired default true and independently disableable. Consume canonical schema/policy/ordered command/build-proof/material/story-files/proof checks plus exact or trusted metadata-only HEAD lineage. validate:false is skipped_explicitly without reuse/execution/manufacture. Human/JSON expose disposition, result, refusalReasons, timeoutLayer. Reconcile exact-HEAD canonical wording.
items.userSees: done_prepare reports disposition “reused”, “executed”, or “skipped_explicitly”; JSON separately reports result, refusalReasons, timeoutLayer, and existingEvidenceBasis “fresh|stale|missing”.

happy.desc: With reuseFreshDoneRequired omitted/default true and a canonical PASS receipt bound to current schema, policy, ordered command specs, material/story-files hashes, build proof, proof admissibility, and exact HEAD lineage, done_prepare does not spawn validation and reports disposition=reused, result=pass, refusalReasons=[], timeoutLayer=null, existingEvidenceBasis=fresh. WHY: proves redundant work is avoided only from admissible proof.

Repeat with evidence HEAD as an ancestor of current HEAD and every intervening changed path classified as trusted story metadata while story-owned material and canonical bindings remain current; reuse succeeds and records trusted metadata-only lineage. WHY: covers the legitimate evidence-commit fixed point.

edge.desc: Set reuseFreshDoneRequired=false with validate=true and otherwise fresh evidence; done_prepare forces one execution, reports disposition=executed, and refreshes evidence from the run. WHY: proves reuse is independently disableable and not coupled to other validation reuse switches.

Set validate=false with fresh, stale, and missing evidence; every case reports disposition=skipped_explicitly, result=not_run, performs neither reuse nor execution, and creates/modifies no DONE-required evidence. WHY: prevents skipped validation from manufacturing assurance.

For executed failure, timeout, policy/config block, and explicit skip, structured output stays within disposition executed|reused|skipped_explicitly and result pass|failed|timed_out|blocked|not_run, with deterministic refusalReasons and timeoutLayer only when relevant; human wording matches. WHY: keeps automation and operator UX aligned.

Under validate=false, present canonical fresh evidence, structurally stale evidence, and no evidence in turn; existingEvidenceBasis is respectively fresh, stale, and missing while disposition remains skipped_explicitly and result remains not_run in all three cases. WHY: separates observation of prior proof from authorization to consume or create proof.

adversarial.desc: Mutate each binding independently—schema, policy hash, command-set/order/spec digest, material hash, storyFilesHash, build proof, proof admissibility, and receipt coverage; reuse fails closed with precise refusalReasons and validate=true executes or blocks rather than claiming reused. WHY: defends against stale or partial proof.

Present malformed, failed, partial, or unreadable evidence and race a metadata change between freshness evaluation and execution decision; no PASS is synthesized, disposition is never reused unless one consistent snapshot satisfies the canonical evaluator, and fallback has one terminal outcome. WHY: closes corruption and TOCTOU paths.

Compare exact current HEAD, trusted metadata-only descendant lineage, unrelated metadata-like paths outside the allowlist, a non-ancestor evidence HEAD, and any lineage containing even one code/config/non-metadata path; only exact HEAD and the fully trusted metadata-only descendant may reuse, every other path is rejected with lineage-specific refusalReasons. WHY: prevents a broad metadata classifier from admitting intervening material drift.

Mechanically inspect all six canonical Workstream A documents after the change; each states the same exact-or-trusted-metadata-only HEAD rule, validate:false semantics, structured disposition/result/evidence-basis vocabulary, timeout precedence, and heartbeat safety, with no surviving exact-HEAD-only contradiction. WHY: prevents runtime, gate registry, and operator guidance from diverging.

verificationEvidence.note: The evaluator-level exact-HEAD fixture independently asserts reusable=true and lineage=exact-head before any metadata auto-commit.
Actual done_prepare CLI integration observes the evidence auto-commit as a trusted story-metadata descendant and asserts disposition=reused/result=pass with lineage=trusted-story-metadata-descendant.
reuseFreshDoneRequired=false asserts disposition=executed/result=pass, execution progress, and changed receipt endedAt proving evidence refresh.
validate=false fresh/stale/missing/malformed matrix asserts skipped_explicitly/not_run and byte-for-byte evidence immutability.
Real executed pass and command/idle/max timeout terminals stay within structured vocabulary, JSON remains singular, and failures exit nonzero.
validate=false independently observes existingEvidenceBasis fresh, stale, and missing without authorizing reuse or execution.
Independent mutations cover evidence schema, policy/command identity and order, receipt coverage, material/story hashes, build proof, and enforced proof-admissibility command-spec failure.
Truncated JSON and malformed shape become stale and recover by execution; injected concurrent HEAD move refuses reuse with one terminal outcome.
Lineage matrix separately covers exact HEAD, trusted descendant, non-ancestor HEAD, metadata-like path outside allowlist, code/config path, modify-then-revert, and rename history.
Contract verifier and all six canonical documents align on lineage, validation structure, cooperative timeout cleanup, and precise no-child not-applicable semantics.

items.title: Keep direct DONE-required validation observably alive and bounded
items.context: Bridge direct done_required_validate progress/heartbeat to ctx.log without corrupting JSON stdout. Preserve command/phase/idle/max deadlines, process-tree and lock cleanup, timer races, and diagnostic-only log sink failure semantics.
items.userSees: direct done_required_validate prints periodic “validate heartbeat” lines; --json remains one result, and a throwing/closed progress sink cannot change command PASS/FAIL.

happy.desc: Run direct done_required_validate with an active command silent longer than default idle but within command, derived phase, and max budgets; periodic validate heartbeat reaches ctx.log, resets CLI liveness, and the command ends PASS. WHY: reproduces and prevents the observed false idle kill.

Run direct done_required_validate --json for the same heartbeat-producing command; stdout contains exactly one parseable result object with disposition=executed/result=pass, while progress uses logging/stderr and never contaminates JSON. WHY: preserves machine-readable output.

edge.desc: Set explicit LATTICE_IDLE_TIMEOUT_MS and LATTICE_MAX_TIMEOUT_MS above and below derived defaults; both remain authoritative, heartbeat only refreshes idle activity, and max expiry is classified timeoutLayer=max rather than phase/command. WHY: proves liveness does not weaken explicit safety bounds.

Verify done_prepare and direct CLI progress bridges use the same JSON-safe formatter without duplicate heartbeat lines or result records; frequently noisy and completely silent commands both settle once. WHY: covers reporter composition boundaries.

Complete just before and just after command, derived phase, idle, and max boundaries; each run yields one stable result and attributes the earliest controlling bound without contradictory result/refusalReasons/timeoutLayer fields. WHY: exercises deadline ordering.

Use a progress sink that throws, closes, or rejects writes while the validation command independently passes and fails; sink errors are contained as diagnostic-only, never change command PASS/FAIL, never replace evidence, and do not produce an unhandled rejection. WHY: keeps observability failure outside assurance semantics.

adversarial.desc: Hang a child that spawns descendants and trigger command, phase, idle, and max termination separately; each path kills the process tree, clears heartbeat/deadline timers, releases the validation lock, and permits an immediate subsequent validation. WHY: verifies cleanup across every timeout layer.

Emit heartbeat concurrently with abort/exit/error events at the deadline; no heartbeat occurs after terminal output, no double resolve/reject or duplicate evidence write occurs, and lock/process cleanup remains idempotent. WHY: catches event-loop deadline races.

Keep the heartbeat timer alive while the child is genuinely wedged; per-command, derived phase, and explicit absolute max still terminate it with result=timed_out and correct timeoutLayer. WHY: proves heartbeat is liveness reporting, not deadline extension.

verificationEvidence.note: Real direct silent command stays alive beyond idle through periodic heartbeat and completes PASS within command/derived/max budgets.
Direct --json stdout is exactly one parseable terminal object while progress and heartbeat remain on stderr.
Explicit idle and max below/above defaults remain authoritative; heartbeat refreshes idle only and max is attributed timeoutLayer=max.
done_prepare and direct progress remain JSON-safe; quiet/noisy paths emit one result and preflight omits unobserved validation fields.
Deterministic injected future/expired deadline seams and abort-at-start ordering complement real pass/command/idle/max subprocess terminals without narrow just-before wall-clock races.
Synchronous throwing and asynchronous rejecting diagnostic sinks preserve independent FAIL/PASS and do not produce unhandled rejection.

Actual spawned descendants are killed and ESRCH-verified for command, DONE-required phase, CLI idle, and CLI max, followed by immediate rerun. Pure in-process closeout phases spawn no child, so descendant ESRCH is explicitly not applicable there.
Abort triggered concurrently at command_start asserts exactly one command_timeout/end, no heartbeat after terminal, and at most one evidence write.
Genuinely wedged children continue diagnostic heartbeats yet command/idle/max absolute bounds terminate with structured timed_out and correct layer.
